nameOrigin: rock with inscription in a graveyard

pokedexEntries.sc: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

pokedexEntries.vi: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

pokedexEntries.za: At some point during the many years it spent guarding the gravestone of its dearly departed master, it was reborn as a ghost Pokémon.
